## Load libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
clean_df <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                             "01_dat_load.tsv.gz"), 
                            col_names = TRUE,     
                            show_col_types = FALSE)

clean_gtf <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                              "01_gtf_load.tsv.gz"),
                             col_names = TRUE,
                             show_col_types = FALSE)

```

## Clean data

```{r}
clean_df <- clean_df |>   
  drop_na(gene_name) |>   
  mutate(sample_id = basename(dirname(file))) |>   
  select(c("sample_id",             
           "gene_id",             
           "gene_name",             
           "gene_type",             
           "unstranded",
           "tpm_unstranded"))

clean_gtf <- clean_gtf |>
  filter(feature == "exon") |>
  mutate(gene_id = str_extract(attr,
                               '(?<=gene_id ")[^"]+'))

# should i add this to the data frame?
```

## Write data file

```{r}
readr::write_tsv(clean_df,
                 file.path(data_dir, 
                           "02_dat_clean.tsv.gz"))


```
